violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings
violation_type.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed  have protrusions or openings that can entangle something around a child s neck or a child s clothing.

finding_variants.text: All outdoor equipment observed  have protrusions or openings that can entangle something around a child s neck or a child s clothing.
Multiple nail bolts were sticking out of the black barrier on the playground structure.
Bolts along the plastic boarders around both play areas were observed to be proturding out of the boarder. This was corrected when the director hammered the bolts down.

One play equipment has long strings with cans attached that could be a risk for entanglement. Some cans have sharp edges. Note: This was corrected at inspection when the strings were removed from the play equipment.
Multiple silver nail bolts were sticking out of the black barrier on the playground structure

There was a pink tricycle out on the playground that had a broken basket which had sharp edges that could cut a child.  (NOTE:  Corrected during inspection as the toy was removed from the playground.)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: One entanglement hazard was observed on the playground where there was a crack found at the top of a slide.  One protrusion hazard was observed where a large bolt was protruding out from a wooden play awning.  The operation will not allow children on these items until they are in compliance.  A safety plan will be implemented.
